View selected work What I do

Work

Digital marketing, done end to end

I'm JP, a Digital Marketing student at UW Oshkosh managing day-to-day marketing for four programs — School of Business, MBA, Sales Program, and School of Education & Human Services — working directly with each program's leadership.

I run social media across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn (alumni spotlights, student features, event coverage, new program launches), write the Business Bulletin — a Constant Contact newsletter reaching 1,500+ business students — and ran a Meta ad campaign. With admin access to UWO's website, I build and edit pages in WordPress and Divi Builder, and contributed to the content migration to UWO's new site. On social, I also shoot photography and edit video content, plus design supporting materials like banners and flyers.

I'm also exploring AI in marketing — building websites with AI-assisted tools and developing agents geared toward marketing and optimization.

Certifications: Digital Marketing (Skillshare/Skukent), Social Media (HubSpot), and a Property and Casualty insurance license from Erie Insurance.

Selected work

Campaigns, content, and the systems behind them

Each project below covers strategy through execution — I plan it, build it, publish it, and report on it.

SEO & AEO

AI-Driven SEO/GEO/AEO Websites

I optimize for both traditional and AI-driven search — technical and on-page SEO paired with generative-engine optimization (GEO) and answer-engine optimization (AEO) to help content surface in AI overviews and featured answers, not just standard results.

SEO / GEO / AEO Web development

AI & automation

AI-Driven Automation

I build AI agents for predictive marketing — analyzing current campaign performance to identify what's working and forecast what should run next.

AI agents Predictive analytics

Video production

Titans Day of Giving

Produced the campaign video from an approved script — coordinating voice-over talent, sourcing footage and stills from campus partners, and editing the final cut for the university's annual giving push.

Premiere Pro Video editing Production coordination

Partnership campaign

UWO × Plexus alumni spotlight

A three-post social collaboration with Plexus: an intro post surfacing the UWO alumni working there, a spotlight featuring alumni employees, and a closing thank-you for hiring UWO students. Co-branded to both organizations' guidelines.

Brand partnership Social strategy Copywriting

Account management

Titan Connect account handoff

Documented and transitioned a full client account to an incoming content specialist — content calendar process, brand standards, platform access, and a paired posting period so nothing dropped during the switch.

Process documentation Brand governance Training

UWO Sales Program

Day-to-day marketing management for the Sales Program — recruitment content, event promotion, photography, and the reporting that shows program leadership what's landing with students.
